name: pr_check
title: Check PR readiness
description: Show all the information to check before creating a PR

directory.description: Target Git repository (absolute or relative path)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

remoteUrl.description: URL of the primary git remote

pushed.description: Whether the current branch is pushed and even with its remote branch

pushStatus.description: Push status as shown in the Push Status section

baseBranch.description: Remote branch compared against (remote/branch): the lower stage when stacked, else the develop branch

commits.description: Commits since the base branch, as shown in the Commits section

diffSummary.description: Diff stat against the base branch, as shown in the Diff Summary section

isWorktree.description: Whether the directory is a linked worktree (omitted when it could not be determined)

stashList.description: Stash list, as shown in the Stash List section

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
